intervals.label: DAMA/NaI data taking (seven annual cycles)
intervals.note: Start: year only (the review); the 2003 DAMA paper dates the DAMA/NaI-5 data to August 1999 - July 2000, DAMA/NaI-6 to November 2000 - July 2001 and DAMA/NaI-7 to August 2001 - July 2002, and the first data release to 1996. End: the collaboration's own statement.
intervals.quote: DAMA/NaI which ran from 1995 to 2002 at LNGS.

intervals.label: completed
intervals.note: Month precision; the collaboration says DAMA/NaI 'has completed its data taking in July 2002'; the DAMA/LIBRA installation started the same year.
intervals.quote: the DAMA/NaI set-up (~100 kg highly radiopure NaI(Tl)), which has completed its data taking in July 2002.

placements.note: Start 1995 (year) and end July 2002 as in the experiment intervals; see their notes.
placements.quote: which has been operative at the Gran Sasso National Laboratory of the I.N.F.N. for more than one decade

crystal_count.quote: nine 9.70 kg highly radiopure NaI(Tl) scintillators especially built for this purpose

depth.note: Average depth of the Gran Sasso laboratory as quoted by the 2026 review (1,400 m of rock); the hall of the DAMA set-up is not given.
depth.quote: under 1,400 m of rock overburden, equivalent to an average depth of 3,800 meters of water equivalent (m.w.e.)

exposure.note: Total exposure of the seven annual cycles.

target_mass.note: Nominal mass of the set-up; the annual-modulation analysis used nine 9.70 kg crystals.
target_mass.quote: about 100 kg highly radiopure NaI(Tl) DAMA experiment (DAMA/NaI)

summary.plain: About 100 kg of highly radiopure sodium iodide crystals (nine crystals of 9.7 kg), read by photomultiplier tubes, inside copper, lead, polyethylene and concrete shielding at Gran Sasso.
summary.technical: Nine NaI(Tl) crystals of 9.70 kg, two PMTs each, 10 cm quartz light guides, sealed Cu box flushed with high-purity nitrogen, Cu/Pb/Cd foils/polyethylene-paraffin shield and 1 m of concrete (arXiv:astro-ph/0307403).

technology.quote: nine 9.70 kg highly radiopure NaI(Tl) scintillators especially built for this purpose
technology.value: Array of nine highly radiopure NaI(Tl) scintillating crystals read by photomultiplier tubes
